title: NEURON-LEVEL ANALYSIS OF CULTURAL UNDERSTANDING IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy and performance degradation on culturally diverse multiple-choice and short-answer benchmarks (BLEnD, CulturalBench, NormAd, WorldValuesBench) that test everyday knowledge, etiquette, and values across different countries, specifically observing how masking identified 'culture-general' and 'culture-specific' neurons impacts cultural understanding.
